confidence_notes: The RBA rate is the latest figure I could confirm from search, dated 2026-11-18. I found no 2026-11-19 observation. Food and drink anchors rest on Numbeo's Taichung, Taipei and Taitung pages, which are crowdsourced and undated in the results, plus a few older Hengchun/Kenting reviews that gave rough meal and beer prices. I found no Kenting-specific coffee, cocktail or wine prices. Cocktail and wine are set from their usual ratio to beer in Taiwan's tourist areas. I added a resort-town premium over the Taitung figures. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against listings. Kenting prices swing widely between peak weekends or summer and weekdays or off-season, so the accommodation estimates are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Taitung and Taichung (Numbeo) as the base for Taiwanese food and drink prices, with a modest uplift for Kenting's beach-resort tourism. Accommodation is based on general knowledge of Taiwan's southern coastal resort towns.
